**Checking the time step, and why the check allows 0.5%.** The model advances in
fixed time steps of 0.1 s. A shorter step should give almost the same result. Before
each new version is published, a test reruns the first minute of the default
sevoflurane induction with steps of 0.1 s, 0.05 s and 0.025 s. Each run's alveolar,
